claim_text: A high-capacity lithium-ion secondary battery comprising: a cathode comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide; an anode comprising a silicon-graphite composite with nano-silicon particles dispersed in carbon; and a non-aqueous liquid electrolyte comprising fluoroethylene carbonate additive.

expected_limitations.text: cathode comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide
anode comprising a silicon-graphite composite with nano-silicon particles dispersed in carbon
non-aqueous liquid electrolyte comprising fluoroethylene carbonate additive

claim_text: A solid-state composite electrolyte membrane for an all-solid-state lithium battery comprising: an inorganic sulfide-based solid electrolyte represented by Li6PS5Cl argyrodite; and a fluorinated copolymer binder comprising vinylidene fluoride and hexafluoropropylene units.

expected_limitations.text: inorganic sulfide-based solid electrolyte represented by Li6PS5Cl argyrodite
fluorinated copolymer binder comprising vinylidene fluoride and hexafluoropropylene units

claim_text: A lithium secondary battery comprising: a positive electrode comprising single-crystal particles of lithium transition metal oxide represented by Li1+a(NixMnyCoz)O2 wherein x is at least 0.80; and a surface coating layer comprising zirconium oxide and boron oxide disposed on the single-crystal particles.

expected_limitations.text: positive electrode comprising single-crystal particles of lithium transition metal oxide represented by Li1+a(NixMnyCoz)O2 wherein x is at least 0.80
surface coating layer comprising zirconium oxide and boron oxide disposed on the single-crystal particles

claim_text: A solvent-free dry electrode film for an electrochemical cell comprising: an active material in an amount between 85% and 98% by weight; and a fibrillized polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder matrix forming a three-dimensional network of interconnected polymeric microfibrils encapsulating the active material.

expected_limitations.text: solvent-free dry electrode film comprising an active material in an amount between 85% and 98% by weight
fibrillized polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder matrix forming a three-dimensional network of interconnected polymeric microfibrils

claim_text: A solid electrolyte membrane for an all-solid-state lithium battery comprising: a polycrystalline ceramic body having a garnet crystal structure of formula Li7-xLa3Zr2-xTaxO12; and an amorphous lithium borosilicate grain boundary passivating phase present at grain boundaries of the polycrystalline ceramic body.

expected_limitations.text: polycrystalline ceramic body having a garnet crystal structure of formula Li7-xLa3Zr2-xTaxO12
amorphous lithium borosilicate grain boundary passivating phase present at grain boundaries

claim_text: A protected negative electrode for a lithium secondary battery comprising: a lithium metal layer; and an artificial solid-electrolyte interphase (SEI) layer formed on the lithium metal layer comprising a cross-linked network of fluorinated siloxane oligomers having fluoroalkyl side chains.

expected_limitations.text: artificial solid-electrolyte interphase (SEI) layer comprising a cross-linked network of fluorinated siloxane oligomers having fluoroalkyl side chains

claim_text: A positive electrode active material for a secondary battery comprising: olivine particles represented by the formula Li1+aMnxFe1-xPO4 wherein 0.55 <= x <= 0.80; an inner amorphous carbon coating layer covering the olivine particles; and an outer conductive matrix comprising graphene sheets interconnecting the olivine particles.

expected_limitations.text: olivine particles represented by the formula Li1+aMnxFe1-xPO4 wherein 0.55 <= x <= 0.80
inner amorphous carbon coating layer covering the olivine particles and outer conductive matrix comprising graphene sheets

claim_text: An anode active material for a lithium secondary battery comprising: composite particles comprising a porous silicon core and a carbon coating layer disposed on the porous silicon core, wherein the porous silicon core has an internal pore volume of 0.35 cm3/g to 0.80 cm3/g to buffer silicon volume expansion during lithiation.

expected_limitations.text: composite particles comprising a porous silicon core and a carbon coating layer
porous silicon core has an internal pore volume of 0.35 cm3/g to 0.80 cm3/g to buffer volumetric expansion
